The '''weak nuclear interaction''' is one of the four [[fundamental interactions]] between [[quantum particle]]s.

== Properties ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
| Carrier particle
| $W^+,W^-,Z^0$ [[boson]]s
|-
| Participants
| Radioactive particles
|-
| Effective range
| $10^{-18} \mathrm{m}$
|}

<ref>{{#cite:Q2545}}</ref>

=== Proton-electron scattering ===

$$
e^- + p \rightarrow n + \nu_e
$$
